title: In-depth comparative immunotoxicity assessment of pristine and aged PLA microplastics in zebrafish larvae: Bioaccumulation and NF-kappaB signaling insights.
authors: Qian, Qiuhui; Li, Lihang; Pu, Qian; Wu, Ji; Xu, Li; Cheng, Ying; Cheng, Guanchen; Yan, Jin; Wang, Zejun; Wang, Xuedong; Wang, Huili
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PLA微塑料对斑马鱼幼鱼的免疫毒性，仅涉及NF-kappaB蛋白与塑料的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Polylactic acid (PLA) plastics are widely utilized as biodegradable alternatives, yet their fragmentation into microplastics (MPs) poses ecological risks. Comprehensive assessments and mechanistic insights into their immunotoxicity are currently lacking. This study systematically evaluated immunotoxic effects and underlying mechanism of pristine and aged PLA (APLA) MPs in larval zebrafish. UV treatment resulted in surface fragmentation, bond cleavage, reduced particle size, and increased oxygen-containing functional groups. Larval exposure (6-120 hpf) to PLA/APLA led to preferential intestinal accumulation, with APLA showing greater bioaccumulation than PLA. Under the influence of intestinal digestive enzymes, PLA/APLA MPs underwent degradation to varying extents. Additionally, PLA/APLA exposure intensified oxidative stress, evidenced by increased SOD activity and excessive accumulation of ROS, MDA, and NO. It also increased innate immune cells, suppressed T-cell differentiation, and inhibited humoral immunity, with stronger effects observed for APLA. Mechanistic studies revealed that PLA/APLA activated the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, as evidenced by stable binding of PLA to NF-kappaB1 and NF-kappaB2 in molecular docking analysis. This was further validated by reduced immunotoxic effects upon treatment with the NF-kappaB inhibitor QNZ. These findings provide critical scientific evidence to guide the forecasting and prevention for the environmental health risk of biodegradable plastic particles.
abstract_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）塑料被广泛用作可生物降解替代品，但其碎裂成微塑料（MPs）对生态构成风险。目前缺乏对其免疫毒性的全面评估和机制性见解。本研究系统评估了原始和老化PLA（APLA）微塑料对斑马鱼幼鱼的免疫毒性效应及其潜在机制。紫外线处理导致表面碎裂、键断裂、粒径减小及含氧官能团增加。幼鱼暴露（6-120小时受精后）于PLA/APLA导致优先肠道积累，其中APLA的生物累积性高于PLA。在肠道消化酶作用下，PLA/APLA微塑料发生不同程度的降解。此外，PLA/APLA暴露加剧了氧化应激，表现为SOD活性增加及ROS、MDA和NO的过量积累。它还增加了先天免疫细胞，抑制了T细胞分化，并抑制了体液免疫，其中APLA的效应更强。机制研究表明，PLA/APLA激活了NF-kappaB信号通路，分子对接分析中PLA与NF-kappaB1和NF-kappaB2的稳定结合证实了这一点。NF-kappaB抑制剂QNZ处理后免疫毒性效应降低进一步验证了该结果。这些发现为预测和预防可生物降解塑料颗粒的环境健康风险提供了关键科学证据。
